europe_now.title: Polish officials say crater likely from Russian missile
europe_now.summary: Polish officials stated that a deep crater left by an explosion was probably caused by a Russian missile.

top_stories.title: European wildfires and heatwave impacts
top_stories.summary: Wildfires on Crete led to evacuations and resulted in firefighter deaths. Authorities in Spain, France and the United Kingdom warned that megafires illustrate how climate change is threatening their way of life.

top_stories.title: Russia-Ukraine conflict and Polish airspace concerns
top_stories.summary: Polish officials said a large crater left by an explosion was likely caused by a Russian missile. Meanwhile, Russian strikes hit Ukraine and were reported to have violated Polish airspace.

top_stories.title: Migration arrivals and EU crisis plan gaps
top_stories.summary: Hundreds of migrants entered Spain's North African territory of Ceuta from Morocco. An EU crisis plan showed that individuals unable to wait 72 hours for assistance are being left behind.

top_stories.title: French wildfire evacuations and improving conditions
top_stories.summary: Tens of thousands of French wildfire evacuees were allowed to return home after the fires subsided. Cooler weather and potential rain moved into the French region that had been torched by wildfires.
